name: qrqrqr – offline QR scanner
description: Click the toolbar button, point a code at your camera, get a list of copyable scans. Decoding runs locally in WebAssembly; nothing leaves your machine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; default-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob: mediastream:
